$comment: Hacking Growth — evidence rules. Kontribusi utama: rule RAISE untuk sinyal positif organik (internal-docs §9 P2) + pembeda demand vs retention.

evidence_rules.condition: evidence perilaku: customer lama kembali/repeat atau mereferensikan orang lain TANPA diminta (organik)
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS specific repeat purchases or unprompted referrals by existing customers (e.g. 'ada yang balik beli lagi', 'dia bawa temannya ke sini') as observed events, not as intentions.

consequence.rationale: Repeat & referral organik = bukti level Behavior bahwa nilai benar-benar diterima — trust deficit menurun. Ini rule RAISE organik pertama untuk DM5.5 (menjawab internal-docs §9: mesin skeptis butuh daya konfirmasi).

evidence_rules.evaluation_note: Predicate deteksi bahasa repeat/referral; LLM matcher tetap wajib menyaring intention ('nanti dia pasti balik') dari event lampau. Sitasi kutipan user wajib.

evidence_rules.condition: users cannot articulate the customer's aha moment AND most new customers don't reach first value
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS being unable to describe a concrete first-value moment when asked when customers 'get it', and acknowledges most new customers stall or disappear before experiencing the core value.

consequence.rationale: Aha moment tak terdefinisi + mayoritas tak sampai = onboarding frictions truktur; retensi rapuh sebelum scale acquisition.

evidence_rules.condition: user complains 'customers are hard to come by' BUT doesn't know the distribution of existing customer sources (can't tell which channel is working)
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS complaining about hard-to-get customers while admitting they have no breakdown of where current customers actually come from — acquisition is discussed purely as a feeling, never as channels with numbers.

consequence.rationale: Tanpa data channel, 'sepi' tidak bisa didiagnosis (distribution inactivity vs demand tak ada). FLAG agar probe HG-P03 dijalankan sebelum intervensi channel dipilih.

evidence_rules.condition: evidence: seluruh energi dicurahkan ke akuisisi customer baru, existing customer tidak pernah dihubungi lagi setelah transaksi
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS all activity as chasing new customers, with zero recurring touch (no broadcast, no check-in, no offer) to people who already bought — existing buyers exist only as past transactions.

consequence.rationale: Relasi berhenti di transaksi = hubungan transaksional murni; trust/ repeat asset tidak dibangun. Sinyal DM5.5 dan biaya akuisisi struktural tinggi.

evidence_rules.condition: A channel experiment exists with measurable baseline vs treatment — demand generation is being tested, not guessed.
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS running a growth/acquisition experiment with a written hypothesis and a baseline metric for the channel.

consequence.rationale: High-tempo experimentation dengan metrik baseline adalah cara Hacking Growth menghasilkan demand yang terukur — bukan perasaan bulan ini.

evidence_rules.condition: More clients coincide with worse retention/quality — the engine is being pushed past what delivery can sustain.
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS customer quality or retention visibly degrading as the number of active clients grows.

consequence.rationale: Retention yang retak saat volume naik adalah sinyal kapasitas delivery mentok dari sisi demand — scaling menambah keretakan (retention gate).
